basis: P1 fixes 10000 draws; P3 adopts the same conservative engineering minimum before pilot validation
sufficiency: Monte Carlo floor only; not evidence of sampling coverage or power

degeneracy.latency_arm_rule: an arm is information-free when its e2e SD < max(timer_resolution_ms, latency_min_cv * mean e2e)
degeneracy.latency_basis: timer_resolution_ms is an absolute measurement floor, not a variability claim: perf_counter on the reference host is mach_absolute_time with 4.17e-8 s resolution (reports/kb-e0/quality-hardening/timer-resolution.txt); 1 us is a conservative cross-host floor 24x coarser. latency_min_cv 1e-4 is relative: 1/2000 of the 0.2 relative-latency margin, so a trace whose arm varies less than that cannot move a p95 ratio decision and is treated as constant. The absolute-only 0.1 ms floor of v2 held informative traces with mean <= 20 ms (third review table 1-4).
degeneracy.latency_ratio_basis: Degeneracy of the relative comparison is judged on the SD of per-block paired log ratios log(candidate/control), not on CI width. It is scale-free and does not shrink with the block count, so more data never turns an informative pass into unverified (fourth review: CV 0.3% passed at 1,000 blocks and was unverified at 5,000 under the v3 width floor 5e-4). 1e-4 matches latency_min_cv: 1/2000 of the 0.2 relative margin. Only an exactly zero or NaN ratio CI width remains a separate degenerate_ratio_ci guard (tied p95 blocks).
degeneracy.quality_basis: 0.001 = noninferiority margin 0.05 / 50. Degeneracy is judged on the question-level SD of each metric delta (and of dev pilot deltas for power), not on CI width: width shrinks with more clusters, so a width floor turned informative large evaluations inconclusive (SD 0.01 was degenerate at 4,000 clusters under v3). An SD below the floor is practically constant (float noise is ~1e-16) and cannot establish pass or power. Only an exactly zero or NaN interval is a separate guard. Real per-question delta SD is typically near 0.1, so power=established from a pilot near this floor is optimistic and must not be used as approval evidence before a measured pilot.
degeneracy.scope: Pre-registered engineering floors before any real pilot; recheck on measured traces. Exceeding them is necessary, not sufficient, for an informative interval.
